Enterprise AI is moving deeper into regulated workflows, not just productivity sidebars.

Google Cloud and Devoteam announced work around Gemini Enterprise for financial-services and legal use cases, with emphasis on agents, governance, security, and implementation support.

A few signals stand out:
- industry-specific agent workflows are becoming the sales motion;
- integration and controls matter as much as model capability;
- regulated sectors are asking for deployment patterns that can survive audit and risk review.

For banks and other regulated enterprises, the lesson is practical: the AI platform decision increasingly includes control design, identity, logging, and change management from day one.
